name: USDA: attaché (GAIN) reports, World Markets and Trade, ERS outlook
access: public: GAIN API and PDFs, FAS PSD circulars, ERS publications
note: GAIN reports are written by USDA's overseas posts and are not official USDA estimates; the official number is the one in the report's own table (USDA Official). Following the desk's rule, the points show how far Post is from USDA and how Post changed its own numbers, not the levels alone.

entries.title: ERS Sugar and Sweeteners Outlook: November 2026 — U.S. 2026/27 Sugar Supply and Use Are Lowered
key_points: For 2026/27, U.S. sugar supply is reduced 238,000 short tons, raw value (STRV) from last month to 14.149 million STRV.
Domestic sugar production is down almost 250,000 STRV to 8.520 million, the lowest since the weather-reduced 2019/20 output.
U.S. 2026/27 sugar use is decreased 96,000 STRV to 12.426 million, solely on a reduction to sugar deliveries for human consumption, in line with the adjusted 2025/26 volume.

entries.title: FAS Sugar: World Markets and Trade, November 2026 — China Sugar Deficit Falls to 10-Year Low, Curbing Imports
key_points: Lead story: China's deficit shrinks to ~2.4 Mt in 2025/26 (lowest in a decade) on output of ~12.9 Mt and weak demand; imports cut to ~4.2 Mt and 3.6 Mt in 2026/27; stocks rising toward 4.5 Mt while domestic prices fall and ICE No. 11 is up >20%.
World 2026/27: production 178.1 Mt (−5%), consumption 176.4 Mt (flat), exports 61.5 Mt (−5%), ending stocks 39.8 Mt (−12%, lowest since 2011/12).
India 29.5 Mt (−0.5 Mt), exports −13% to 3.1 Mt and stocks the lowest in 20 years; Brazil 40.5 Mt (−3 Mt) after heavy Centre-South rain, exports 31.7 Mt (−7%).

entries.title: Brazil: Sugar November Update
key_points: Wet September–October slowed the crush and cut TRS: cane 681 Mt (−2%), sugar 40.5 Mt (−4%), exports 31.7 Mt (−4.8%); mix kept at 49% sugar.

MY 2026/27, Post vs USDA official: production 40.50 Mt vs 42.50 Mt (−2.00 Mt); exports 31.72 Mt vs 33.60 Mt (−1.88 Mt); consumption 8.80 Mt vs 9.00 Mt (−200 kt); ending stocks 300 kt vs 221 kt (+79 kt).
MY 2025/26, Post vs USDA: production 43.30 Mt vs 43.80 Mt.

Post's own revision since its Sugar Semi-annual (Oct 2026), MY 2026/27: production 40.50 Mt from 42.20 Mt (−4.0%); exports 31.72 Mt from 33.30 Mt (−4.7%); consumption 8.80 Mt from 9.00 Mt (−2.2%); ending stocks 300 kt from 221 kt (+35.7%).

entries.title: Thailand: Sugar Semi-annual
key_points: El Niño to cut cane yield and extraction; dry weather also threatens new plant cane for 2027/28. 2025/26 exports raised; more of 2026/27 exports to be refined as raws lose share to Brazil and Australia in Indonesia and Malaysia.
MY 2026/27, Post vs USDA official: exports 7.00 Mt vs 6.00 Mt (+1.00 Mt); ending stocks 10.90 Mt vs 13.45 Mt (−2.56 Mt).
MY 2025/26, Post vs USDA: production 12.00 Mt vs 11.26 Mt; exports 8.30 Mt vs 6.00 Mt; ending stocks 11.70 Mt vs 13.25 Mt.
Post's own revision since its Sugar Annual (Apr 2026), MY 2026/27: exports 7.00 Mt from 6.00 Mt (+16.7%); ending stocks 10.90 Mt from 12.45 Mt (−12.5%).

entries.title: ERS Sugar and Sweeteners Outlook: October 2026 — U.S. 2026/27 Sugar Supply Is Raised; Use is Reduced
key_points: US 2026/27 supply +119k STRV to 14.39m on larger beginning stocks; output −71k to 8.77m; food deliveries −50k; ending stocks +168k to 1.87m (stocks/use 14.9%).
Louisiana's early crop lifts 2025/26 cane sugar to a record 4.24m STRV.

entries.title: Brazil: Bracing for Impact - How the 2026 El Nino Affects Brazil's Agriculture
key_points: El Niño brief: heat and dryness risk in central/northern Brazil (coffee flowering), excess rain in the south.

entries.title: Philippines: Sugar Semi-annual
key_points: Red-striped soft scale, El Niño and input costs: raw output forecast cut; no exports until the export policy is issued.
MY 2026/27, Post vs USDA official: production 1.70 Mt vs 1.93 Mt (−230 kt); ending stocks 376 kt vs 704 kt (−328 kt).
MY 2025/26, Post vs USDA: production 1.85 Mt vs 1.95 Mt; exports 99 kt vs 100 kt; ending stocks 655 kt vs 753 kt.
Post's own revision since its Sugar Annual (Apr 2026), MY 2026/27: production 1.70 Mt from 1.93 Mt (−11.9%); ending stocks 376 kt from 704 kt (−46.6%).

entries.title: Pakistan: Sugar Semi-annual
key_points: Output unchanged at 6.91 Mt; with good stocks the export forecast goes up to 500k t.
MY 2026/27, Post vs USDA official: exports 500 kt vs 300 kt (+200 kt); ending stocks 2.07 Mt vs 1.97 Mt (+100 kt).
MY 2025/26, Post vs USDA: exports 200 kt vs 500 kt; ending stocks 2.46 Mt vs 2.16 Mt.
Post's own revision since its Sugar Annual (Apr 2026), MY 2026/27: exports 500 kt from 300 kt (+66.7%); ending stocks 2.07 Mt from 1.97 Mt (+5.1%).

entries.title: European Union: Sugar Semi-annual
key_points: Record-low beet area plus a severe summer drought: smallest EU crop since quotas ended; exports more than halve, imports rise, stocks drawn down.

MY 2026/27, Post vs USDA official: production 13.15 Mt vs 14.35 Mt (−1.20 Mt); exports 658 kt vs 858 kt (−200 kt); imports 2.15 Mt vs 2.55 Mt (−400 kt); consumption 15.70 Mt vs 15.90 Mt (−200 kt); ending stocks 266 kt vs 656 kt (−390 kt).
MY 2025/26, Post vs USDA: production 16.26 Mt vs 15.52 Mt; exports 1.77 Mt vs 1.26 Mt; ending stocks 1.32 Mt vs 511 kt.

Post's own revision since its Sugar Annual (Apr 2026), MY 2026/27: production 13.15 Mt from 14.35 Mt (−8.4%); exports 658 kt from 858 kt (−23.3%); imports 2.15 Mt from 2.55 Mt (−15.7%); consumption 15.70 Mt from 15.90 Mt (−1.3%); ending stocks 266 kt from 656 kt (−59.5%).

entries.title: Brazil: Sugar Semi-annual
key_points: El Niño-linked irregular rain slows Centre-South crushing: some mills will crush into the off-season and cane will carry into 2027/28; North-Northeast near normal.
MY 2026/27, Post vs USDA official: production 42.20 Mt vs 42.50 Mt (−300 kt); exports 33.30 Mt vs 33.60 Mt (−300 kt).
MY 2025/26, Post vs USDA: production 43.30 Mt vs 43.80 Mt.
Post's own revision since its Sugar Annual (Apr 2026), MY 2026/27: production 42.20 Mt from 42.50 Mt (−0.7%); exports 33.30 Mt from 33.60 Mt (−0.9%).

entries.title: Australia: Sugar Semi-annual
key_points: Dry since April: cane cut to 27.9 Mt (−1.8%), but high sugar content lifts sugar +4.4% to 4.0 Mt.
MY 2026/27, Post vs USDA official: production 4.00 Mt vs 4.18 Mt (−180 kt); exports 3.51 Mt vs 3.61 Mt (−101 kt).
MY 2025/26, Post vs USDA: exports 2.63 Mt vs 2.71 Mt; ending stocks 1.35 Mt vs 1.27 Mt.
Post's own revision since its Sugar Annual (Apr 2026), MY 2026/27: production 4.00 Mt from 4.18 Mt (−4.3%); exports 3.51 Mt from 3.61 Mt (−2.8%); ending stocks 913 kt from 911 kt (+0.2%).

entries.title: Mexico: Sugar Semi-annual
key_points: Output 5.70 Mt (+1%); the soda tax keeps demand flat; imports −32% after tariff increases; exports +42% as surplus is pushed out.
MY 2026/27, Post vs USDA official: production 5.70 Mt vs 5.45 Mt (+249 kt); exports 1.50 Mt vs 949 kt (+551 kt); ending stocks 1.03 Mt vs 1.18 Mt (−152 kt).
MY 2025/26, Post vs USDA: production 5.64 Mt vs 5.49 Mt; exports 1.06 Mt vs 1.05 Mt; ending stocks 1.30 Mt vs 1.13 Mt.

Post's own revision since its Sugar Annual (Apr 2026), MY 2026/27: production 5.70 Mt from 5.45 Mt (+4.6%); exports 1.50 Mt from 1.12 Mt (+33.9%); consumption 4.18 Mt from 4.15 Mt (+0.7%); ending stocks 1.03 Mt from 948 kt (+8.9%).

entries.title: India: Sugar Semi-annual
key_points: Erratic rain, waterlogging and pests cut yields and recovery: output now below consumption. Steepest price rise in 25 years led to duty-free raw imports, stock limits and an export ban; ending stocks fall sharply.

MY 2026/27, Post vs USDA official: production 29.50 Mt vs 33.60 Mt (−4.10 Mt); exports 3.10 Mt vs 3.60 Mt (−500 kt); consumption 30.83 Mt vs 31.00 Mt (−170 kt); ending stocks 4.00 Mt vs 6.51 Mt (−2.51 Mt).
MY 2025/26, Post vs USDA: exports 3.30 Mt vs 3.50 Mt; ending stocks 6.00 Mt vs 5.08 Mt.

Post's own revision since its Sugar Annual (Apr 2026), MY 2026/27: production 29.50 Mt from 33.60 Mt (−12.2%); exports 3.10 Mt from 3.60 Mt (−13.9%); consumption 30.83 Mt from 31.00 Mt (−0.5%); ending stocks 4.00 Mt from 6.51 Mt (−38.5%).

entries.title: China: Sugar Semi-Annual
key_points: Cane output up and demand flat: imports, including syrup and premix, seen lower as Beijing protects growers.

MY 2026/27, Post vs USDA official: production 13.37 Mt vs 12.70 Mt (+670 kt); imports 3.80 Mt vs 5.45 Mt (−1.65 Mt); consumption 15.80 Mt vs 16.75 Mt (−950 kt); ending stocks 4.58 Mt vs 4.02 Mt (+556 kt).
MY 2025/26, Post vs USDA: production 12.95 Mt vs 12.60 Mt; exports 133 kt vs 160 kt; ending stocks 3.37 Mt vs 2.78 Mt.
Post's own revision since its Sugar Annual (Apr 2026), MY 2026/27: production 13.37 Mt from 12.70 Mt (+5.3%); imports 3.80 Mt from 4.50 Mt (−15.6%); ending stocks 4.58 Mt from 4.02 Mt (+13.8%).

entries.title: ERS Sugar and Sweeteners Outlook: September 2026 — U.S. 2026/27 Sugar Production Is Reduced; Mexico’s 2026/27 Sugar Exports to the United States Are Revised Accordingly
key_points: US 2026/27 supply cut 168k STRV to 14.27m; cane −88k STRV (Florida 1.82m, lowest since 2013/14); imports −186k, mostly from Mexico (US Needs calculation).
Mexico 2026/27 output unchanged at 5.38 Mt.

entries.title: ERS Sugar and Sweeteners Outlook: August 2026 — U.S. 2026/27 Sugar Supply Is Raised; Mexico’s 2025/26 Sugar Production Is Finalized
key_points: US 2026/27 supply +169k STRV to 14.44m (higher stocks and imports); beet −30k and cane −23k STRV (Florida −123k).
Mexico 2025/26 output final at 5.325 Mt (+12% y/y).

entries.title: ERS Sugar and Sweeteners Outlook: July 2026 — Changes to the U.S. 2026/27 Balance Sheet Include Data Revisions From Prior Years; Mexico’s 2026/27 Sugar Production Is Raised
key_points: Multi-year SMD data revisions lower US 2026/27 beginning stocks and raise deliveries; 2025/26 deliveries +57k STRV.
Mexico 2025/26 output raised 74k t to 5.31 Mt on a strong finish; 2026/27 also raised.

entries.title: ERS Sugar and Sweeteners Outlook: June 2026 — U.S. 2026/27 Sugar Deliveries Are Up; Mexico’s 2026/27 Sugar Output Is Raised
key_points: US 2026/27 production raised 254k STRV to 9.06m; 2025/26 deliveries raised 126k STRV.
Mexico 2026/27 output raised 141k t to 5.28 Mt after Post raised area and yield.

entries.title: ERS Sugar and Sweeteners Outlook: May 2026 — U.S. 2026/27 Sugar Supply Is Forecast Lower; Mexico’s 2026/27 Sugar Output Is Mostly Flat
key_points: First US 2026/27 balance: supply 14.06m STRV; output 8.81m, lowest since 2019/20; imports set at minimum levels.
Mexico 2026/27 output 5.14 Mt (−0.7%) from Post's April Annual.

entries.title: Philippines: Sugar Annual
key_points: El Niño and little new area: raw output lower; more refined imports under Sugar Order No. 2; no exports forecast.
MY 2026/27 first forecast by Post (no USDA official number in the report yet): production 1.93 Mt; imports 321 kt; consumption 2.30 Mt; ending stocks 704 kt.
MY 2025/26, Post vs USDA: production 1.95 Mt vs 2.08 Mt; ending stocks 753 kt vs 1.05 Mt.

MY 2026/27 first forecast by Post (no USDA official number in the report yet): production 33.60 Mt; exports 3.60 Mt; imports 2.43 Mt; consumption 31.00 Mt; ending stocks 6.51 Mt.

key_points: US 2025/26 beet sugar cut 33k STRV to 5.06m; deliveries for food raised 94k STRV on direct-consumption imports.
